WITH color_counts AS (
  SELECT product_color, COUNT(*) as color_count
  FROM Products
  WHERE product_color IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY product_color
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(color_count) as total_sum,
    AVG(color_count) as avg_count
  FROM color_counts
),
with_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.color_count,
    CAST(cc.color_count AS REAL) / s.total_sum as ratio,
    (cc.color_count - s.avg_count) as excess
  FROM color_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE cc.color_count > s.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(color_count) as total_kept_counts,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_count_divided_by_sum,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excesses
FROM with_ratios
